name: Drum Kit
description: Synthesized drum kit for quiet music: twelve soft drums, one on each key of the octave, made from sines, noise and filters, with the octave of the key tuning the drum.

params.name: Kit
params.description: The character of the whole kit: soft and round, deep and long, tight and bright, or dry like paper and card. Heard from the next hit.

params.name: Tune
params.description: Tunes every drum up or down, the same way the octave of the key played does. Heard from the next hit.

params.name: Length
params.description: How long every drum rings, from short dry taps to long tails. Heard from the next hit.

params.name: Punch
params.description: How far and how fast the kick and toms fall in pitch as they start, and how hard their first moments are. Heard from the next hit.

params.name: Snap
params.description: The click on the kick, the noise on the snare and the bite at the front of the hats. At zero every drum starts soft. Heard from the next hit.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Dull to bright: a low-pass over the tonal drums and the upper edge of the noise drums.

params.name: Drive
params.description: Soft saturation over the whole kit with its level made good, so more of it is thicker and not louder.

params.name: Variation
params.description: How much each hit differs from the last in level, tone, length and noise. At zero every hit of a drum is the same. Heard from the next hit.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the hats, shaker, clap, rim, tick and toms sit from the centre. At zero the kit is mono. The kick and sub stay in the middle.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the kit. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many drums land together.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Every drum is synthesized the way analogue drum voices usually are (a swept sine, filtered noise, a bank of detuned pulses for the hats); nothing is sampled and no circuit is modelled.
